name: VSIX Publish Lint
subtitle: Find the package.json lines that stop vsce before you run the release build
free: Lints the extension manifest you have open against all 16 rules and names, line by line, the exact field to change
paid: Lints every extension manifest in the workspace in one pass and writes the result out as a JSON or SARIF file you keep and run in CI
need_key: This option needs a licence (VSIX Publish Lint).
